values.title: Presence
values.summary: Show who's online and what they're doing with shared, ephemeral state.
values.body:
## Joining a channel

TypeScript

```
const room = realtime.channel(`project:${projectId}`)
 
room.presence.track({ name: user.name, cursor: null })
room.presence.onChange((people) => showAvatars(people))
```

## Broadcast

Send short-lived events, like cursor positions or typing indicators, that don’t need to be stored.

TypeScript

```
room.broadcast("cursor", { x, y })
room.on("cursor", ({ x, y }, from) => moveCursor(from, x, y))
```

Throttle cursors

Broadcast cursor positions at most every 50ms to stay well under channel limits.
